unsupported: Electric Inc. is an electrical contracting and solar installation firm based in Sheridan, Wyoming.
Ownership details and founders are not publicly disclosed.
It operates as a service provider rather than a manufacturer, with no reported facility size, headcount, or production volumes.
Electric serves residential homeowners, commercial building owners, industrial facilities, and agricultural clients such as farms and ranches across northern Wyoming.
Its founders aimed to build a relationship-driven business that maintains open communication from first contact through project completion.
